title: Subject Lock, Seedream relighting in one render, local upscaler fixed
notes:
- Seedream 5.0 Pro copies a cutout's shading exactly, so above 'match' the app now pre-shades the cutout toward your scene's key light (worked out in a 2-3 second text step) and describes that light on the car in the prompt. Still one render, same price - verified render by render
- Subject Lock (on by default): the cutout's box rides in the prompt as Seedream 5.0 Pro's official keep-unchanged region tag - free, no extra image, and lighting creativity keeps working. Works with Aspect = Auto and with any ratio from the dropdown: the cutout is letterboxed into that frame first (same scale and placement, the margins grow). Needs a transparent cutout
- Silhouette mask is deprecated (old and unstable, it will be removed soon); it still steps aside while Lighting is above keep
- No more thumbnails popping into the generating screen while a batch runs
- AIP Upscaler (local ComfyUI) works off the owner's machine at last: the upscaler workflow ships with the app, model files are found wherever your ComfyUI keeps them, and a run refuses to start until ComfyUI, the models and the workflow are all in place (the bell says exactly what is missing)
- AIP Upscaler shows every step with a real timer (starting ComfyUI, uploading, queued, upscaling, saving), Cancel stops it, a ComfyUI the app started closes with the app, the two studio model files download like the others
- Bell: the setup card clears when the upscaler is ready, download progress survives a re-check, a stalled model download resumes, cards can be dismissed
